rows.forward_scope_title: Camp construction and visual upgrade system

Allow documented footprint/port changes with route/relocation proof. Preserve paid repair, Level1 replacement and furnace recovery rules.

rows.forward_scope_title: Ten-world progression architecture — 50 local levels per world
rows.current_scope: Own ten worlds×50 local levels and versioned progression identity. Every upgrade milestone must map visible change to an authored capability worth purchasing; world levels, equipment levels and visual stages remain distinct. Do not invent caps or500 outcomes.

Re-author challenge for fifty local levels, stronger earned defenses and simultaneous companions without spend inputs. Preserve the full five-minute active warning, feasible recovery and readable distinct attacks; no arbitrary stats inflation or unmeasured population-cap claim.
Design and prove old-to-new world/local save migration, accepted quote stability, completed milestone preservation, update availability and rollback.
Recheck customer/worker density, queues and routes as World 1 adds products, counter variants and enlarged camp stages.

Design meaningful fishing/food-processor upgrades with actual acquisition, intake, processing and output gains, appropriate actions and clear routes. Numeric recipes/rates and new unlocks require authoring/tuning; fishing does not automatically move into the Level1 opening.

rows.source_name: Customer service, physical payment and reinvestment
rows.forward_scope_title: Customer service, physical payment and reinvestment
rows.current_scope: Make counter upgrades visibly useful through authored mixed-product handling, customer pickup/cash separation and service flow. Support multiple unlocked survivor logistics without duplicate stock/payment; no spawned cashier and no fake unlimited-capacity purchase.

Tie conveyor/machine/storage connections to real production input/output and handling improvements. Preserve selected belt/resource unit scale; parallel runs or moved ports require documented function, cost, clearance, full/blocked/resumed and exact shared-cargo tests.

Give crop and food-chain upgrades meaningful visible production changes tied to authored inputs, processing/output and helper actions. Validate actual value and resource identity; do not infer fixed unlocks or recipe ratios from decorative variants.
Recheck road/vehicle-customer unlocks and traffic with the expanded camp and drivable snow truck; customer vehicles and the owned truck remain distinct systems.

rows.source_name: Visible hostiles, hunting and weapon progression
rows.forward_scope_title: Visible hostiles, hunting and weapon progression
rows.current_scope: Support useful weapon/attack progression and multiple friendly fighters with correct target eligibility, contact, interruption and resource drops. Upgrade presentation must reflect real authored capability; retain survivor provocation, pet attacks and truck-contact boundaries.

Give guard towers and defensive structures substantial visible upgrades tied to authored protection/attack capability. Prove targeting, real firing/contact, supply rules, range/coverage, friendly safety, damage and paid recovery; no unsupported damage or invulnerability claims.

rows.source_name: Survivor rescue and basic survivor identity
rows.forward_scope_title: Survivor rescue and basic survivor identity
rows.current_scope: Support multiple living survivors working/defending/attacking simultaneously with visible useful equipment/capability progression. Include hauling, stocking, cash, authorized buying/building/repair/healing, role-specific motions, reservations, budgets and casualty/replacement continuity.

Preserve guardian dog identity and species actions while defining useful visible work/protection/attack upgrades. Support multiple active pets with distinct living instances and jobs; numeric deployment caps and new unlock levels are not fixed by this package.

Preserve gray wolf identity/pursuit/pounce/bite while binding visible upgrades to useful attack/specialty value and multi-pet coordination. Reconcile availability; do not claim staged team limits are measured performance.

Preserve fox identity/scouting/retrieval/attack and authored later-world availability. Any upgrade needs real useful capability and species-specific visuals; simultaneous multi-pet support does not automatically unlock the fox in World1.

Preserve owl flight, clearance, scouting/retrieval and dive/talon actions. Visible gear/capability upgrades must remain airborne-functional and useful with other active pets/survivors; no false fixed cap or new unlock approval.

Preserve lion identity and later-world intent while requiring worthwhile visual attack/work upgrades and concurrent-actor integration. No new World1 acquisition, numeric damage value or model stage is silently approved.

Preserve white tiger identity, distinct attack motion and later-world intent. Upgrade value/appearance must support actual capability and multiple actors without duplicate targets or false acquisition/cap approval.

Preserve bear identity, heavy hauling and approved obstacle/attack actions. Define useful visual/capability gains for concurrent actors under its authored availability; do not invent a World1 unlock or universal tool permission.

rows.source_name: Integrated companion jobs and population safety
rows.forward_scope_title: Integrated companion jobs and population safety
rows.current_scope: Prove multiple pets and multiple survivors simultaneously active, beyond roster ownership: useful distinct jobs/attacks/guard roles, recall, stable targets, reservations, budgets, pathing, deadlock recovery, casualty and save/offscreen handoffs. Preserve prior3-pet/2-escort staged proposal separately from local workers; no new cap is ratified.
